country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 destination, for example GBR.
country.title: Country

shippingAccountName.description: Required when the account has multiple shipping accounts. Manifests all eligible orders in Label Generated and Despatched statuses.
shippingAccountName.title: Shippingaccountname

startDateTime.description: Optional lower bound for order filtering. The first complete poll establishes a baseline without emitting historical orders.
startDateTime.title: Startdatetime

countryIsoCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. GBR, USA)
countryIsoCode.title: Countryisocode

isRecipientABusiness.description: Indicates if the recipient is a business or not. Mandatory for Business senders on orders shipping from Great Britain to Northern Ireland, which require additional information for B2B shipments. (Business senders are OBA accounts and OLP accounts declaring themselves as a Business sender).
isRecipientABusiness.title: Isrecipientabusiness

subtotal.description: The total value of all the goods in the order, excluding tax. This should not include retail shipping costs
subtotal.title: Subtotal

shippingCostCharged.description: The shipping costs you charged to your customer
shippingCostCharged.title: Shippingcostcharged

customsDutyCosts.description: Customs Duty Costs is only supported in DDP (Delivery Duty Paid) services
customsDutyCosts.title: Customsdutycosts

total.description: The sum of order subtotal, tax and retail shipping costs
total.title: Total

deliveryTerm.description: Specifies how customs duties, taxes, and handling fees are paid for international shipments. Accepted values are  DDP, IOSS_DDP, DDU_DAP, IOSS_DDU, DTP, IOSS_DTP .   N.B. If no value is provided, the delivery term saved on your account is used, or DDU_DAP if none is saved.
deliveryTerm.title: Deliveryterm

customsDeclarationCategory.description: Customs Declaration Category for the whole order. When provided it is used instead of the product level categories.
customsDeclarationCategory.title: Customsdeclarationcategory

orderTax.description: The total tax charged for the order
orderTax.title: Ordertax

containsDangerousGoods.description: Indicates that the package contents contain a dangerous goods item
containsDangerousGoods.title: Containsdangerousgoods

dangerousGoodsUnCode.description: UN Code of the dangerous goods
dangerousGoodsUnCode.title: Dangerousgoodsuncode

dangerousGoodsQuantity.description: Quantity or volume of the dangerous goods
dangerousGoodsQuantity.title: Dangerousgoodsquantity

shippingAccountName.description: The name of the shipping account to use for this order. Required if the account has more than one shipping account. Must match a shippingAccountName returned by GET /carriers.
shippingAccountName.title: Shippingaccountname

AIRNumber.description: For B2B orders shipping from Great Britain to Northern Ireland, this field can be used to provide the Recipient UKIMs number.
AIRNumber.title: Airnumber

commercialInvoiceNumber.description: This field has been deprecated. Use commercialInvoiceNumber at the package level instead.
commercialInvoiceNumber.title: Commercialinvoicenumber

commercialInvoiceDate.description: This field has been deprecated. Use commercialInvoiceDate at the package level instead.
commercialInvoiceDate.title: Commercialinvoicedate

SKU.description: The presence or not of field  SKU  and other fields in the request body will determine which of the following behaviours occur:-  1) A minimum of  SKU ,  unitValue ,  unitWeightInGrams  and  quantity  provided - In addition to the provided product fields being used for the order creation, an existing account Product with matching SKU will be overwritten with all provided product parameters. If no existing account Product with matching SKU can be found then a new product will be created with the provided SKU and product parameters. 2)  SKU ,  quantity  provided and  no other fields  provided - An account Product with the provided SKU will be used for the order if it exists. 3)  SKU not provided  and a minimum of  unitValue ,  unitWeightInGrams  and  quantity  provided - All provided product fields will be used for the order creation. 4) All other scenarios will result in a validation error. Required for EU shipments on items declared as eCommerceSaleOfGoods or commercialSaleOfGoods
SKU.title: Sku

ReferenceId.description: The non-standardised manufacturer's product reference code for the item. This field will be deprecated in the future. Please use 'NonStandardisedManufacturerId' instead.
ReferenceId.title: Referenceid

ContentsPieceURL.description: A URL linking directly to the specific product page for the item being shipped. Must point to an individual product listing, not a general shop homepage or category page.
ContentsPieceURL.title: Contentspieceurl

NonStandardisedManufacturerId.description: The non-standardised manufacturer's product reference code for the item.  Required for EU shipments on items declared as eCommerceSaleOfGoods or commercialSaleOfGoods
NonStandardisedManufacturerId.title: Nonstandardisedmanufacturerid

StandardisedManufacturerId.description: The standardised manufacturer's product reference code for the item (e.g. GTIN, EAN, UPC).  If NonStandardisedManufacturerId isn't provided, this value is also used as the NonStandardisedManufacturerId.
StandardisedManufacturerId.title: Standardisedmanufacturerid

PgaReferenceNumber.description: The PGA (Partner Government Agency) reference number for the item. Can only contain A-Z, 0-9, spaces, full stops, hyphens and forward slashes.  USA Shipments only
PgaReferenceNumber.title: Pgareferencenumber

quantity.description: The number of units in a given line
quantity.title: Quantity

unitValue.description: The price of a single unit excluding tax
unitValue.title: Unitvalue

customsDescription.description: A description of the goods in the item, used for customs.
customsDescription.title: Customsdescription

addressBookReference.description: The presence or not of  addressBookReference  and a valid  recipient address object  in the request body will determine which of the following behaviours occur:-  1) addressBookReference  provided  and a valid recipient address object  provided  - In addition to the provided recipient address fields being used for the order creation, an existing account Address Book Reference with matching addressBookReference will be overwritten with all provided recipient address fields, including phone and email. If no existing account Address Book Reference with matching addressBookReference can be found then a new one will be created with the provided addressBookReference and address fields, including phone and email. 2) addressBookReference  provided  and a valid recipient address object  not provided  - An account Address Book Reference with the provided addressBookReference will be used for the order if it exists. 3) addressBookReference  not provided  and a valid recipient address object  provided  - All provided recipient address fields, including phone and email, will be used for the order creation. 4) All other scenarios will result in a validation error.
addressBookReference.title: Addressbookreference

phoneNumber.description: Either phoneNumber or emailAddress is required for USA shipments.
phoneNumber.title: Phonenumber

emailAddress.description: Either phoneNumber or emailAddress is required for USA shipments.
emailAddress.title: Emailaddress

serviceCode.description: Return service code. Obtain available values from GET /returns/services.
serviceCode.title: Servicecode

packageFormatIdentifier.description: If you have a ChannelShipper account, you can also pass the name of any of your custom package formats instead of the values below.   Enum: 'undefined', 'letter', 'largeLetter', 'smallParcel', 'mediumParcel', 'largeParcel', 'parcel', 'documents'
packageFormatIdentifier.title: Packageformatidentifier

customPackageFormatIdentifier.description: This field will be deprecated in the future. Please use 'packageFormatIdentifier' for custom package formats from ChannelShipper.
customPackageFormatIdentifier.title: Custompackageformatidentifier

commercialInvoice.description: Commercial invoice encoded as a base64 PDF string, under 2MB.
commercialInvoice.title: Commercialinvoice

supportingDocuments.description: Optional supporting documents, each encoded as a base64 PDF string, under 2MB.
supportingDocuments.title: Supportingdocuments

commercialInvoiceNumber.description: Commercial invoice number for this package.
commercialInvoiceNumber.title: Commercialinvoicenumber

commercialInvoiceDate.description: Date of the commercial invoice for this package. If a commercial invoice is provided without a date, the current date is used. The current date is also used if the minimum value '0001-01-01' is supplied.
commercialInvoiceDate.title: Commercialinvoicedate

status.description:
" despatchedByOtherCourier  ":  Reserved for ChannelShipper customers only - please visit
 ChannelShipper.com  for more information 

" new  ": This will remove the order from its batch. Order information will not be lost during this process.

Please be aware labels generated on orders which are then set to "new" (reset) are no longer valid
and must be destroyed. If the order is required to be despatched after setting to "new" status, a new
label must be generated to attach to the item.

Cancelled label information is automatically shared with Royal Mail Revenue Protection, and should a
cancelled label be identified on an item in the Royal Mail Network, you will be charged on your account
and an additional handling fee applied.
status.title: Status

manifestIdentifier.description: Manifest number returned by Manifest Eligible Orders.
manifestIdentifier.title: Manifestidentifier

RoyalMailAPITokenCredential.title: Royal Mail API Token
RoyalMailAPITokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: In ChannelShipper or Royal Mail Click & Drop, open Settings → Integrations → Royal Mail API and copy the API token. Paste only the token, without Bearer. Account features determine whether ChannelShipper details, OBA labels/returns or OLP services are available.

ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart

ScheduleConfig.title: ScheduleConfig

items.description: Exactly one orderIdentifier or orderReference per item. Resetting to new cancels existing labels: destroy them and generate replacements before shipping.
items.title: Items

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
